abstract: We study the optimal design of a monopoly platform that interacts with heterogeneous firms and consumers who face uncertainty about product values and prices. Consumers search randomly among firms recommended by the platform. The platform designs a menu of contracts tailored to different firm types and allocates consumer visits across these firms. We show that the optimal platform design creates a “superstar effect,” whereby high‐type firms capture a disproportionately large market share, and improves consumer welfare relative to the no‐design benchmark.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个垄断平台的最优设计问题，该平台与异质性企业以及面临产品价值和价格不确定性的消费者进行互动。消费者在平台推荐的企业中进行随机搜索。平台针对不同类型的企业设计了一套定制化合同菜单，并将消费者访问量分配给这些企业。研究表明，最优平台设计会产生“超级明星效应”，即高类型企业获得不成比例的巨大市场份额，并且与无设计基准相比，该设计能够改善消费者福利。
title: Consumer Search, Firm Heterogeneity, and Platform Design
title_zh: 消费者搜索、企业异质性与平台设计

abstract: We study oligopolistic competition by firms practicing second‐degree price discrimination. In line with the literature on demand estimation, our theory allows consumers' propensity to switch brands to vary with tastes for product quality. If low‐type consumers are sufficiently more (respectively, less) prone to switch brands than are high types, (i) quality provision is inefficiently low at the bottom (respectively, high at the top) of the product line, and (ii) informational rents are positive (respectively, negative) for high types and negative (respectively, positive) for low types. Interestingly, we show that an increase in the number of competing firms may decrease welfare (by tightening incentive constraints), so much so that monopoly may be welfare superior to oligopoly. Pure‐strategy equilibria fail to exist, resulting in price‐quality dispersion across firms, whenever the propensity to switch brands is sufficiently different across consumers types.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了实施二级价格歧视的企业在寡头竞争中的行为。与需求估计文献一致，我们的理论允许消费者转换品牌的倾向随其对产品质量的偏好而变化。若低类型消费者比高类型消费者更易（或更不易）转换品牌，则：（i）产品线底端（或顶端）的质量供给将出现低效不足（或过高）；（ii）高类型消费者获得正（或负）信息租金，而低类型消费者获得负（或正）信息租金。有趣的是，我们发现竞争企业数量的增加可能降低社会福利（通过强化激励约束），以至于垄断可能比寡头更有利于社会福利。当不同消费者类型的品牌转换倾向差异足够大时，纯策略均衡将不存在，导致企业间出现价格-质量离散现象。
title: Nonlinear Pricing in Oligopoly: How Brand Preferences Shape Market Outcomes
title_zh: 寡头市场中的非线性定价：品牌偏好如何塑造市场结果

abstract: This article provides a full characterization of the competitive effects of horizontal mergers in the Cournot model with heterogeneous firms and constant marginal costs. We show that price effects depend only on the smaller merging firm's market share and the number of firms but are independent of the distribution of market shares among other firms. Standard concentration measures, instead, are often misleading. We also provide simple—yet general—closed‐form solutions for merger effects based on pre‐merger parameters. Moreover, we extend the model to study the combination of output and input market power and relate our results to the Merger Guidelines.
abstract_zh: 本文全面刻画了异质性企业且边际成本恒定条件下古诺模型中横向合并的竞争效应。研究表明，价格效应仅取决于规模较小合并企业的市场份额及企业数量，而与其他企业的市场份额分布无关。相比之下，标准集中度指标往往具有误导性。我们基于合并前参数，为合并效应提供了简洁而通用的闭式解。此外，我们将模型拓展至产出市场与投入市场势力的联合分析，并将研究结论与《合并指南》相关联。
title: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
title_zh: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应

abstract: We study the market effects of sponsored search auctions for advertising space on searches for brands. In our model, firms simultaneously choose the price of their product and the bids for the advertising auctions triggered by their own and rivals' brand keywords search. In any symmetric equilibrium, each firm wins its own keyword auction, and relative to a no‐ads benchmark, online advertising raises the winning brand's marginal cost and ultimately market prices. Only in an environment with strong initial asymmetries do we find that brand advertising might be beneficial.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了品牌搜索中赞助搜索广告拍卖的市场效应。在模型中，企业同时选择产品价格以及针对自身和竞争对手品牌关键词搜索触发的广告拍卖出价。在任何对称均衡中，每家企业都能赢得自身关键词拍卖；与无广告基准相比，在线广告提高了获胜品牌的边际成本，并最终推高了市场价格。仅在初始不对称性较强的环境中，我们才发现品牌广告可能是有益的。
title: Market Effects of Brand Search Advertising
title_zh: 品牌搜索广告的市场效应

abstract: This article examines the welfare consequences of a trade association in an exporting country on consumers in destination countries. We estimate a structural model of the Chilean Salmon exporting industry that endogenizes firms' pricing and export decisions. Our results show that the trade association has a positive effect on consumer utility and involves higher marginal costs of production, consistent with higher quality products. Reduced form analysis estimates price effects associated with trade association membership of 3 to 8 percent. Our counterfactual analysis reveals that eliminating the trade association would reduce consumer welfare by 1.7 billion USD in destination countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了出口国行业协会对目的地国家消费者的福利影响。我们构建了智利鲑鱼出口行业的结构模型，将企业的定价与出口决策内生化。研究结果表明，该行业协会对消费者效用具有正向影响，同时伴随着更高的边际生产成本，这与产品质量提升的结论一致。简化形式分析估计，行业协会成员身份带来的价格效应为3%至8%。反事实分析显示，若取消该行业协会，目的地国家的消费者福利将减少17亿美元。
title: Welfare Effects of Trade Associations: The Case of the Chilean Salmon Export Industry
title_zh: 贸易协会的福利效应：智利鲑鱼出口行业的案例

abstract: Partisan theory predicts that left-leaning governments tolerate higher inflation, and UK data appear to confirm it. Before 1997, inflation averaged three percentage points higher under Labour than the Conservatives. I show this gap is not robust. It is the product of a single Labour government (1974–79) that coincided with the OPEC oil shocks; a randomisation test at the level of governments returns p = 0.50 , and omitting any one of nine governments can swing the gap by up to four points. With so few in the sample, the data cannot sustain the partisan effect they appear to show.
abstract_zh: 党派理论预测，左倾政府更能容忍较高的通货膨胀，英国的数据似乎证实了这一点。1997年前，工党执政期间的平均通胀率比保守党高出三个百分点。我证明这一差距并不稳健。它源于一个特定的工党政府（1974-79年），该时期恰逢OPEC石油冲击；在政府层面的随机化检验得出p=0.50，且剔除九个政府中的任何一个，差距可波动高达四个百分点。鉴于样本量如此之少，数据无法支撑其表面所显示的党派效应。
title: The fragility of the partisan inflation gap: Evidence from the United Kingdom
title_zh: 党派通胀差距的脆弱性：来自英国的证据

abstract: This paper examines the effects of clarifying overlapping land rights on Mailo land in Central Uganda, contributing to broader debates on property rights and rural development. The study leverages a quasi-experimental design implemented across three districts, where interventions included systematic demarcation of parcel boundaries and land inventories, dissemination of legal knowledge, conflict mediation services, and facilitation of tenant–landlord agreements. Drawing on a panel of Mailo tenants, a large-N tenant survey, and a survey of landlords, we assess how land rights awareness raising shaped institutional clarity (improved documentation and legal awareness), tenure security (reduced conflict and strengthened perceptions of security), and economic behavior (evidence of land market activity). The findings highlight the central role of annual Busuulu (ground rent) payments—functioning simultaneously as a rent obligation and as formal evidence of tenant rights—as a mechanism linking institutional reforms to greater tenure security and market participation. We further identify heterogeneous effects, with distinct patterns for female-headed households and for tenants with kinship ties to landlords on all three outcomes. Taken together, the results provide new evidence on the mechanisms through which property rights interventions shape security and economic activity in rural Africa.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了澄清乌干达中部梅洛土地重叠权属对制度明晰度、产权安全及经济行为的影响，为产权与农村发展的更广泛讨论提供了新证据。研究采用准实验设计，在三个地区实施干预措施，包括地块边界的系统划定与土地清册编制、法律知识传播、冲突调解服务以及促进租户与地主间协议达成。基于梅洛租户面板数据、大规模租户调查及地主调查，我们评估了土地权利意识提升如何塑造制度明晰度（改善文件记录与法律认知）、产权安全（减少冲突并强化安全感知）及经济行为（土地市场活动的证据）。研究结果凸显了年度布苏鲁（地租）支付的核心作用——其同时作为租金义务和租户权利的正式凭证——成为连接制度改革与增强产权安全及市场参与的关键机制。我们进一步识别出异质性效应，在女性户主家庭及与地主存在亲属关系的租户中，三项结果均呈现不同模式。总体而言，本研究为产权干预如何影响非洲农村安全与经济活动提供了机制层面的新证据。
title: Clarifying overlapping land rights in semi-formal systems: The case of Mailo tenant lands in Uganda
title_zh: 厘清半正式体系中的重叠土地权利：乌干达Mailo租户土地案例

abstract: Long-standing tensions exist for firms in developing economies between fulfilling social responsibility mandates and securing sustainable growth. This study leverages China's Targeted Poverty Alleviation (TPA) initiative to demonstrate that corporate participation in poverty reduction serves as a strategic and sustainable investment, simultaneously advancing societal development and providing financing support. Specifically, we find that TPA participation significantly reduces firms' financing costs, an effect that is amplified by greater TPA investment intensity and assistance difficulty. Particularly for firms with limited political connections, TPA financing benefits are boosted through social responsibility credit substituting for traditional political capital. Moreover, balanced equity configurations significantly intensify these cost-reduction effects. Mechanistically, by responding to state-led institutional pressures, firms secure political resources such as fiscal subsidies and tax relief that further ease financing burdens. Meanwhile, TPA reduces information asymmetries and elevates corporate social governance ratings, thereby enhancing creditworthiness and access to credit from banks and suppliers. Motivation analyses confirm that TPA engagement stems from a strategic objective rather than an attempt to conceal corporate misconduct. Overall, our findings illuminate a transformative pathway for emerging markets: converting national institutional pressures into strategic leverage allows firms to achieve both societal objectives and long-term financial resilience.
abstract_zh: 发展中经济体的企业在履行社会责任与确保可持续增长之间长期存在张力。本研究利用中国精准扶贫（TPA）倡议，证明企业参与减贫是一种战略性和可持续的投资，同时推动社会发展并提供融资支持。具体而言，我们发现TPA参与显著降低了企业的融资成本，且这一效应因更高的TPA投资强度和帮扶难度而增强。尤其对于政治关联有限的企业，TPA融资收益通过社会责任信用替代传统政治资本而得到提升。此外，均衡的股权配置显著强化了这些降成本效应。在机制上，通过响应国家主导的制度压力，企业获得财政补贴和税收减免等政治资源，进一步缓解融资负担。同时，TPA降低了信息不对称并提升了企业社会治理论评级，从而增强信用度及从银行和供应商获取信贷的渠道。动机分析证实，TPA参与源于战略目标而非掩盖企业不当行为的企图。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了新兴市场的一条转型路径：将国家制度压力转化为战略杠杆，使企业能够同时实现社会目标与长期财务韧性。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Corporate social responsibility as sustainable financial strategy: Evidence from China's targeted poverty alleviation
title_zh: 企业社会责任作为可持续财务战略：来自中国精准扶贫的证据

abstract: Objective To assess the economic evidence on school-based prevention and mental health promotion interventions, focusing on costs and outcomes across key societal sectors, including healthcare, education, social care, criminal justice, as well as in productivity and individual expenses. Design A systematic review with narrative synthesis was conducted following the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis approach, including an assessment of monetised outcomes across all sectors and an additional analysis of non-monetised outcomes in the education sector. Study quality was appraised using Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards (CHEERS) and Consensus Health Economic Criteria (CHEC). Data sources Medline, Embase, PsycINFO, Econlit, ERIC and Scopus. Eligibility criteria for selecting studies Economic evaluations of school-based prevention or mental health promotion interventions for children or adolescents in Europe that report outcomes across healthcare and other societal sectors. Results 20 studies were included, comprising different types of economic evaluations as well as trial-based and model-based evaluations. Based on the primary analyses reported in the studies, which consider costs and benefits across multiple societal sectors, most evaluations suggested favourable economic outcomes. Benefits exceeded costs in four out of five (80%) cost–benefit analyses (average cost–benefit ratio of 5.14). Half of the cost-effectiveness analyses found that interventions were more effective but also more costly than the comparator while two interventions were both more effective and less costly. In cost–utility analyses, 9 out of 10 (90%) fell below commonly used thresholds for good value for money. Reported outcomes covered healthcare, education, social care, criminal justice sectors, as well as productivity and individual expenses. Pronounced cost savings from included interventions were observed in productivity and healthcare, with improvements also observed in non-monetised education outcomes. Study quality was mixed. Conclusions School-based mental health interventions yield cross-sectoral economic benefits and, in many cases, societal returns on investment, in both the short and longer term, by influencing key determinants of health and well-being across multiple sectors.
abstract_zh: 目的 评估基于学校的预防与心理健康促进干预措施的经济学证据，重点关注关键社会部门（包括医疗、教育、社会照护、刑事司法）以及生产力和个人支出中的成本与结果。设计 采用无荟萃分析的综合方法进行系统综述与叙述性综合，包括对所有部门的货币化结果进行评估，并对教育部门的非货币化结果进行额外分析。研究质量采用《卫生经济学评价报告标准》（CHEERS）和《卫生经济学评价共识标准》（CHEC）进行评估。数据来源 Medline、Embase、PsycINFO、Econlit、ERIC 和 Scopus。研究选择标准 针对欧洲儿童或青少年开展的基于学校的预防或心理健康促进干预措施的经济学评价，且报告涉及医疗及其他社会部门的结果。结果 共纳入20项研究，涵盖不同类型的经济学评价，包括基于试验和基于模型的评价。基于研究报告的主要分析（考虑多个社会部门的成本与收益），大多数评价显示有利的经济结果。在五项成本-收益分析中，四项（80%）显示收益超过成本（平均成本-收益比为5.14）。半数成本-效果分析发现干预措施比对照措施更有效但成本更高，而两项干预措施既更有效又成本更低。在成本-效用分析中，90%（10项中的9项）低于常用的物有所值阈值。报告的结果涵盖医疗、教育、社会照护、刑事司法部门，以及生产力和个人支出。纳入的干预措施在生产力与医疗领域观察到显著的成本节约，同时在非货币化的教育结果方面也观察到改善。研究质量参差不齐。结论 基于学校的心理健康干预措施通过影响多个部门中健康与福祉的关键决定因素，在短期和长期内均能产生跨部门的经济效益，并在许多情况下带来社会投资回报。
title: Beyond health: a systematic review of cross-sector economic implications of school-based mental health programmes in Europe
title_zh: 超越健康：欧洲学校心理健康项目跨部门经济影响的系统综述

abstract: Data sharing not applicable to this article as no datasets were generated or analysed during the current study.
abstract_zh: 本文不适用数据共享，因为当前研究未生成或分析任何数据集。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Australia's Search for Greener Pastures: The Foundations of the Global Genetic Resources Movement, 1926–1980. By Derek Byerlee, Canberra, ACT: The Crawford Fund, 2025, 71 pp. ISBN: 978‐1‐7640211‐0‐4.
title_zh: 澳大利亚寻找更绿的牧场：全球遗传资源运动的基础，1926–1980

abstract: This study analyses weekly port calls from 2019 to 2026 to evaluate the Russia–Ukraine war's impact on maritime trade. The data reveals clear structural shifts that Ukrainian traffic moved from high‐risk areas like Odesa to safer Danube River ports. On the other hand, Russia sustained its maritime activity by navigating sanctions and redirecting exports to Asian markets. The Black Sea Grain Initiative also improved navigation conditions for both countries. Overall, the war caused domestic port substitution within Ukraine and a broader logistical reorganization for Russia.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2019年至2026年的周度港口停靠数据，以评估俄乌战争对海上贸易的影响。数据揭示了明显的结构性转变：乌克兰的航运从敖德萨等高危地区转移至更安全的多瑙河港口。另一方面，俄罗斯通过规避制裁并将出口转向亚洲市场，维持了其海上活动。黑海谷物倡议也改善了两国的航行条件。总体而言，战争导致了乌克兰国内港口的替代效应，并引发了俄罗斯更广泛的物流重组。
title: The Impact of Russia–Ukraine War in Maritime Data
title_zh: 俄乌战争对海事数据的影响

abstract: Government procurement is a key demand-side policy tool for state intervention in the economy, as it not only directly influences micro-corporate decision making but also shapes regional industry dynamics. Nevertheless, its industry-level impacts remain underexplored. This study adopts the perspective of firm entry and exits to investigate how government procurement shapes regional industry dynamics. We find that government procurement significantly increases the entry of new firms in regional industries while also promoting firm exit. A series of robustness tests and IV-based causal identification demonstrate the reliability of the result. Mechanism analysis reveals that, on the one hand, by raising the proportion of contracts awarded to local firms, government procurement sends a policy signal of supporting local industry, thereby encouraging both entry and exit. On the other hand, by prefer small and medium-sized enterprises (SME), it enhances market competition and stimulates firm entry and exit. Further analysis shows that: first, government procurement also generates supply-chain spillover effects, extending its influence to upstream and downstream industries; second, the distribution of procurement contracts among firms within an industry moderates the impact of procurement; third, the impact of government procurement on the entry and exit of enterprises ultimately enhances the industry's innovation capability; and finally, the effect of government procurement on firm entry and exit is stronger in regions with a better business environment. This study provides policy insights for optimizing government procurement policies to promote regional industrial development.
abstract_zh: 政府采购是国家干预经济的关键需求侧政策工具，它不仅直接影响微观企业决策，还塑造区域产业动态。然而，其在产业层面的影响尚未得到充分探讨。本研究从企业进入与退出的视角出发，探讨政府采购如何塑造区域产业动态。我们发现，政府采购显著增加了区域产业中新企业的进入，同时也促进了企业的退出。一系列稳健性检验和基于工具变量的因果识别证明了结果的可靠性。机制分析揭示，一方面，通过提高本地企业获得合同的比例，政府采购传递出支持本地产业的政策信号，从而鼓励企业进入与退出；另一方面，通过偏好中小企业，增强了市场竞争，刺激了企业的进入与退出。进一步分析显示：第一，政府采购还产生供应链溢出效应，将其影响延伸至上下游产业；第二，产业内企业间采购合同的分配调节了采购的影响；第三，政府采购对企业进入与退出的影响最终增强了产业的创新能力；最后，在营商环境较好的地区，政府采购对企业进入与退出的影响更为显著。本研究为优化政府采购政策以促进区域产业发展提供了政策启示。

title: Government procurement as a catalyst: Reshaping firm entry-exit dynamics in China
title_zh: 政府采购作为催化剂：重塑中国企业进入与退出动态

abstract: This paper proposes a new adaptive Markov regime-switching copula (A-MRS-Copula) model based on the realized covariance measures to enhance the prediction accuracy of portfolio risk of China’ s new energy and financial markets. More specifically, the model relaxes the static transition probability condition of the traditional MRS-Copula model, allowing the copula parameters to vary adaptively based on high-frequency dependence information between assets. Furthermore, given the leverage effect prevalent in financial markets, we employ realized semicovariances as proxies for intraday dependencies in our modelling process. This approach improves the ability of the model to capture asset leverage effect and accurately depict dynamic dependence. Empirical results show that the A-MRS-Copula model exhibits statistically significant improvement in forecasting portfolio risk in new energy markets and other markets. Finally, robustness tests confirm that the new model outperforms the MRS-Copula model in terms of different data, copula function settings, prediction evaluation methods and rolling window.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于已实现协方差测度的新型自适应马尔可夫机制转换Copula（A-MRS-Copula）模型，旨在提升中国新能源与金融市场投资组合风险的预测精度。具体而言，该模型放宽了传统MRS-Copula模型的静态转移概率条件，允许Copula参数根据资产间高频依赖信息进行自适应调整。此外，针对金融市场普遍存在的杠杆效应，我们在建模过程中采用已实现半协方差作为日内依赖关系的代理变量，从而增强模型捕捉资产杠杆效应与准确刻画动态依赖结构的能力。实证结果表明，A-MRS-Copula模型在新能源市场与其他市场的投资组合风险预测中具有统计显著的改进效果。最后，稳健性检验证实，该新模型在不同数据、Copula函数设定、预测评估方法及滚动窗口条件下均优于MRS-Copula模型。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Can realized covariance measure improve VaR forecasting of China’s new energy and financial markets? ——Evidence from the A-MRS-Copula model
title_zh: 实现协方差能否改进中国新能源与金融市场的VaR预测？——来自A-MRS-Copula模型的证据

abstract: How food prices affect diet quality is an important question to design policies that can improve the nutrition and health of all Americans. This study investigates the association between food‐at‐home diet quality and aggregate food prices to understand if price movements compromise nutrition, and where price‐based policies could be an effective tool to improve population health. Using detailed household purchase data from 2015 to 2018, our findings suggest three insights. First, consumers make substitutions that largely preserve their given level of diet quality, though that level remains poor relative to recommendations for health. Second, we find minimal evidence of heterogeneous responsiveness to prices by diet quality or sociodemographic characteristics. Third, we find evidence that the substitutions consumers make in their protein choices when prices rise increase the healthfulness of their food baskets. Taken together, our study suggests that encouraging healthier diets probably requires more than pricing policies but that price‐based policies targeted at protein may be more effective than other food groups. That we fail to find evidence of differential responsiveness of diet quality to prices suggests that universal (untargeted) policies can be recommended to improve diets across the population. JEL Classification: D12, I12, Q18
abstract_zh: 食品价格如何影响膳食质量，是设计改善全体美国人营养与健康政策的关键问题。本研究探究家庭食品膳食质量与总体食品价格之间的关联，以理解价格波动是否损害营养状况，以及基于价格的政策能否成为改善人口健康的有效工具。利用2015年至2018年的详细家庭购买数据，我们的发现揭示了三个要点。首先，消费者进行的替代行为大体上维持了其既有的膳食质量水平，尽管该水平相对于健康建议而言仍然较差。其次，我们几乎没有发现膳食质量或社会人口特征对价格存在异质性响应程度的证据。第三，我们发现证据表明，当价格上涨时，消费者在蛋白质选择上进行的替代行为提高了其食品篮子的健康程度。综合来看，我们的研究表明，鼓励更健康的膳食可能不仅需要定价政策，但针对蛋白质的基于价格的政策可能比其他食品类别更有效。我们未能发现膳食质量对价格存在差异化响应程度的证据，这表明可以推荐普遍性（非针对性）政策来改善全体人口的膳食。
title: What Happens to Diet Quality When Food Prices Rise? Revealed Preference From National Household Scanner Data, 2015–2018
title_zh: 食品价格上涨时饮食质量如何变化？基于2015–2018年全国家庭扫描数据的显示性偏好分析

abstract: Pathogen‐stress and terror‐management theories predict that lethal epidemics heighten parochial cooperation. We test this prediction experimentally in two nationally representative US samples surveyed before and at the onset of the COVID‐19 pandemic. We compare trust and expected trustworthiness across the two waves in monetarily incentivized trust games involving non‐Hispanic Whites, African Americans and Hispanics. We find significant ingroup favouritism in both waves. However, the aggregate ingroup premium fell by about one‐half between waves. This decline was concentrated among left‐leaning and moderate respondents. While non‐Hispanic Whites tended to reduce their ingroup bias in expected trustworthiness, the opposite was found for African Americans. Respondents more exposed to COVID‐19 displayed higher intergroup trust, altruism and expected trustworthiness than others. These results contradict the hypothesis that lethal epidemics intensify parochialism, also suggesting that the response may be diversified across groups.
abstract_zh: 病原体应激与恐怖管理理论预测，致命性流行病会加剧群体内合作。我们通过两项具有全国代表性的美国样本（分别在COVID-19疫情爆发前后进行调查）对这一预测进行了实验检验。我们比较了涉及非西班牙裔白人、非洲裔美国人和西班牙裔的货币激励信任博弈中两轮调查的信任与预期可信度。研究发现两轮调查均存在显著的群体内偏袒现象。然而，群体内溢价的总量在两轮调查间下降了约一半，这一下降主要集中在左倾和温和派受访者中。非西班牙裔白人倾向于降低其在预期可信度方面的群体内偏见，而非洲裔美国人则呈现相反趋势。相较于其他受访者，更易接触COVID-19的受访者表现出更高的群体间信任、利他主义和预期可信度。这些结果与致命性流行病会加剧群体内偏见的假设相矛盾，同时表明不同群体的反应可能存在差异。
title: Did the outbreak of COVID‐19 and individual exposure to it increase ingroup bias in the USA? An experimental investigation of interethnic trust
title_zh: COVID-19疫情爆发及个体暴露程度是否加剧了美国的内群体偏见？一项关于族裔间信任的实验研究

abstract: We investigate the sources of heterogeneity in producer and consumer price inflation rates at both industry and aggregate levels. To this end, we develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with a production network, which enables us to disentangle the effects of producer price stickiness and consumer price stickiness in the transmission of sectoral shocks—a distinction often overlooked in theoretical models. We demonstrate that sectoral cost-push shocks and network connectivity are key determinants of the relative volatility between producer and consumer price inflation in the U.S. Furthermore, we quantify how these shocks propagate through cascading adjustments in producer prices, ultimately influencing the aggregate consumer price.
abstract_zh: 我们探究了行业及总体层面上生产者与消费者价格通胀率异质性的来源。为此，我们构建了一个包含生产网络的动态一般均衡模型，该模型使我们能够区分生产者价格粘性与消费者价格粘性在部门冲击传导中的作用——这一区别在理论模型中常被忽视。我们证明，部门成本推动冲击和网络连通性是决定美国生产者与消费者价格通胀相对波动性的关键因素。此外，我们量化了这些冲击如何通过生产者价格的级联调整进行传播，最终影响总体消费者价格。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 190
title: Heterogeneous Inflation Volatility in Production Networks: Producer vs. Consumer Prices
title_zh: 生产网络中的异质性通胀波动：生产者价格与消费者价格

abstract: Global trade has shifted from the traditional exchange of finished goods to the widespread integration of global value chains (GVCs). The expansion of GVCs has important implications for both developed and developing economies. We construct a framework to explain how GVC participation affects GDP per capita and how these effects differ across countries at different income levels by analysing types of GVC activities and the mediating role of total factor productivity (TFP). We use advanced econometric methods, including fixed-effects models, two-stage least squares estimators, system generalized method of moments estimators, and fixed-effects quantile regression, to provide detailed insights into the differential effects of GVC participation. Our results show that the impact of GVC participation on economic growth varies by income level. For low-income countries, backward GVC participation significantly affects GDP per capita, while forward GVC participation has significant effects only for upper-middle- and high-income countries. We also find that TFP mediates the impact of GVC participation on GDP per capita.
abstract_zh: 全球贸易已从传统的成品交换转向全球价值链（GVC）的广泛整合。全球价值链的扩张对发达经济体和发展中经济体均具有重要影响。我们构建了一个分析框架，通过考察全球价值链活动的类型以及全要素生产率（TFP）的中介作用，阐释全球价值链参与如何影响人均GDP，以及这种影响在不同收入水平国家间的差异。我们采用先进的计量经济学方法，包括固定效应模型、两阶段最小二乘估计量、系统广义矩估计量以及固定效应分位数回归，以深入揭示全球价值链参与效应的异质性。研究结果表明，全球价值链参与对经济增长的影响因收入水平而异。对于低收入国家，后向全球价值链参与对人均GDP具有显著影响；而前向全球价值链参与仅对中高收入和高收入国家产生显著效应。我们还发现，全要素生产率在全球价值链参与对人均GDP的影响中发挥中介作用。
title: How do countries benefit from participating in the global value chain? A comprehensive panel analysis of heterogeneity in GVC impacts
title_zh: 各国如何从参与全球价值链中获益？GVC影响异质性的综合面板分析

abstract: I take a simple model of linear taxation of labour income and append to it the possibility that the chosen tax schedule triggers conflict in society. I demonstrate theoretically that, under certain assumptions, the resulting set of efficient tax schedules is a proper subset of the set of efficient tax schedules in a standard model without the possibility of conflict. Then, I show in a numerical example that the former set can be much smaller than the latter.
abstract_zh: 我采用一个简单的劳动收入线性税收模型，并加入所选税收方案可能引发社会冲突的可能性。理论上证明，在特定假设下，由此产生的有效税收方案集合是标准模型中无冲突可能性下有效税收方案集合的一个真子集。随后，通过数值示例展示，前者集合可能远小于后者。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Efficient taxation of labour income under the threat of conflict
title_zh: 冲突威胁下的劳动收入有效课税

abstract: This study proposes a general framework for aggregation problems, in which agents’ signals given in an infinite sequence are aggregated. Notably, no restriction is imposed on the set of signals; hence, this framework is applicable to any type of attributes, including preferences, ballots, pieces of information, or judgments. The result can include the empty set that corresponds to the silence of the aggregation rule. Our main focus is to analyze the process by which the structure of the family of decisive coalitions forms a filter or an ultrafilter. In our framework, a coalition is regarded as decisive if a signal is socially approved as long as every agent in the coalition picks the signal up unanimously. First, we show that the family of decisive coalitions forms a filter under a certain axiom representing a stability condition. Next, in the case where the set of signals is finite, we provide axiomatic characterizations of the class of agreement-based rules associated with filters or ultrafilters: a signal is approved if and only if it is a unanimous agreement of some coalition in a specified filter or ultrafilter. Our axiomatic results demonstrate the robustness and stability of such rules.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出一个通用的聚合问题框架，其中代理人在无限序列中给出的信号被聚合。值得注意的是，对信号集合未施加任何限制；因此，该框架适用于任何类型的属性，包括偏好、选票、信息片段或判断。结果可以包括空集，这对应于聚合规则的沉默。我们的主要焦点是分析决定性联盟家族的结构如何形成滤子或超滤子的过程。在我们的框架中，如果一个信号只要联盟中的每个代理一致选择该信号，该信号就被社会认可，则该联盟被视为决定性的。首先，我们证明在代表稳定性条件的特定公理下，决定性联盟家族形成一个滤子。其次，在信号集合有限的情况下，我们提供了与滤子或超滤子相关联的基于一致同意的规则类的公理化特征：一个信号被认可当且仅当它是指定滤子或超滤子中某个联盟的一致同意。我们的公理化结果展示了此类规则的稳健性和稳定性。
title: Filters in abstract aggregation with infinite sequences of signals
title_zh: 无限信号序列下抽象聚合中的滤波器

abstract: Transactions such as kidney sales or surrogacy often evoke repugnance among unaffected observers (spectators). We examine whether individuals directly involved in these transactions (stakeholders) are more accepting. In our lab experiment featuring a transaction with severe consequences and limited agency for the vulnerable party, spectators and vulnerable stakeholders largely deem it repugnant, whereas advantaged stakeholders (who have the right to make offers) are less likely to prohibit it. Spectators and vulnerable stakeholders differentiate between mild and severe outcomes, while advantaged stakeholders are accepting in both cases. All groups are more prohibitive when agency is lacking. Overall, spectators mostly align with the vulnerable, while advantaged stakeholders view the transactions more favorably.
abstract_zh: 诸如肾脏买卖或代孕等交易，往往会在未受影响的旁观者（旁观者）中引发反感。我们考察了直接参与这些交易的个人（利益相关者）是否更为接受。在我们的实验室实验中，涉及后果严重且弱势方代理权有限的交易，旁观者和弱势利益相关者大多认为其令人反感，而优势利益相关者（拥有提出要约权利的一方）则较少倾向于禁止。旁观者和弱势利益相关者会区分轻微与严重后果，而优势利益相关者在两种情况下均持接受态度。当缺乏代理权时，所有群体都更倾向于禁止。总体而言，旁观者主要与弱势方立场一致，而优势利益相关者则对交易持更为积极的态度。
title: Double standards: When stakeholders disagree with spectators in repugnance judgments
title_zh: 双重标准：当利益相关者与旁观者在厌恶判断上产生分歧时

abstract: Rising polarisation heightens concerns about politicising regulatory agencies, prompting reassessment of the accountability–independence trade-off. We study whether perceived out-group oversight affects trust in regulation and market behaviour. Using US television transcripts, we show that media link agencies with presidents. We then conduct a field experiment (N=5,566) using a case where the EPA endorsed antibiotic spraying on citrus crops during both Trump’s and Biden’s presidencies. Holding science constant, out-group oversight reduces support for spraying by 26%, lowers trust in EPA’s evaluation, and increases donations to an opposing NGO by 15%. In an obfuscated follow-up, citrus demand is unchanged, but effects differ by consumption habits.
abstract_zh: 摘要 日益加剧的政治极化引发了对监管机构政治化的担忧，促使人们重新审视问责与独立之间的权衡。本文研究了感知到的外群体监督是否会影响公众对监管的信任及市场行为。通过分析美国电视新闻转录文本，我们发现媒体常将监管机构与总统关联。随后，我们以美国环保署（EPA）在特朗普和拜登总统任期内均批准在柑橘作物上喷洒抗生素的案例为基础，开展了一项实地实验（样本量N=5,566）。在保持科学依据不变的情况下，外群体监督使受访者对喷洒措施的支持率下降26%，对EPA评估的信任度降低，并向反对该措施的NGO捐款增加15%。在一项隐蔽的后续实验中，柑橘需求未发生显著变化，但不同消费习惯群体的反应存在差异。
title: Politics of Food: An Experiment on Trust in Expert Regulation and Economic Costs of Political Polarisation
title_zh: 食品政治：专家监管信任与政治极化经济成本的实验研究

abstract: An understanding of the growth of surgical robotic technology is not only a contribution to the academic literature on the proliferation of new technology, but also it is a precursor to effective U.S. public policies toward this burgeoning new technology and possibly toward potential future standard-setting dimensions of an emerging ecosystem. Using patent application information from filings with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office, we characterize the growth of this technology in terms of a traditional S-curve model. We also hypothesize a theory of the distribution of surgical robotic technology, and we test our theory empirically.
abstract_zh: 对手术机器人技术增长的理解，不仅是对新技术扩散学术文献的贡献，也是美国针对这一新兴技术制定有效公共政策，乃至可能为未来新兴生态系统标准设定维度奠定基础的前提。利用向美国专利商标局提交的专利申请信息，我们以传统的S曲线模型刻画了该技术的增长特征。我们还提出了一个关于手术机器人技术分布的理论假设，并对其进行了实证检验。
title: The Growth of Surgical Robotic Technology
title_zh: 手术机器人技术的发展

abstract: In the context of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation, effective land management emerges as a paramount policy priority worldwide for carbon mitigation and low-carbon transitions. Using the Yangtze River Economic Belt (YEB) as a case study, this study systematically explores the mechanisms and heterogeneity of land transfer’s impact on carbon emissions, taking spatial spillover effects into account. The findings reveal that: (1) newly allocated built-up land has a markedly stronger effect on carbon emissions compared to the redevelopment of existing land, primarily due to the conversion of agricultural and forest land and the built-up of new infrastructure. (2) In 2015–2022, there is an increase in land transfers for industrial, public service, and transportation purposes at the outskirts, while residential and commercial land allocations have decreased, particularly in the lower reaches of the YEB. (3) Industrial land transfers have the most substantial impact on carbon emissions, while emissions from residential and commercial land can be mitigated through energy-efficient technologies and green building standards. (4) Land transfer area (LTA) is positively correlated with carbon emissions, while land marketization (LM) shows a negative influence. Significant spatial autocorrelation was also observed, underscoring the complex spatial dynamics at play in land use and carbon emissions. Based on the findings, policy recommendations are proposed on differentiated land supply management system, optimizing land marketization process, ecological and environmental standards and guidelines to mitigate carbon emissions through integrated land resource management across regions.
abstract_zh: 在温室气体（GHG）减排背景下，有效的土地管理成为全球范围内实现碳减排和低碳转型的首要政策重点。本研究以长江经济带（YEB）为案例，系统探讨了土地流转对碳排放影响的机制与异质性，并考虑了空间溢出效应。研究发现：（1）新增建设用地对碳排放的影响显著强于存量土地的再开发，主要归因于农用地和林地的转换以及新基础设施的建设。（2）2015—2022年间，郊区工业、公共服务和交通用途的土地流转有所增加，而住宅和商业用地配置减少，尤其在长江经济带下游地区表现明显。（3）工业用地流转对碳排放的影响最为显著，而住宅和商业用地的碳排放可通过节能技术和绿色建筑标准得到缓解。（4）土地流转面积（LTA）与碳排放呈正相关，而土地市场化（LM）则呈现负向影响。同时，研究观察到显著的空间自相关性，凸显了土地利用与碳排放之间复杂的空间动态关系。基于研究结果，提出了差异化土地供应管理体系、优化土地市场化进程、生态与环境标准及指南等政策建议，以通过跨区域土地资源综合管理实现碳减排。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Unraveling the spatial dynamics and mechanism heterogeneity of land transfer on carbon emission: Evidence from China’s Yangtze River Economic Belt
title_zh: 土地流转对碳排放的空间动态与机制异质性解析：来自中国长江经济带的证据

abstract: This paper considers the estimation of a censored partial linear quantile regression model with endogeneity. Our method extends those for partial linear quantile regression (Lee, 2003, Qu et al. 2024), nonparametric quantile regression (Qu and Yoon, 2015, Belloni et al., 2019), and censored linear quantile regression with endogeneity (Chen, 2018). Our estimation method involves a tractable sequential-multiple-step procedure. We establish the uniform consistency, the uniform representation and the asymptotic normality for the proposed estimators. We further extend our analysis to allow for sample selection. A set of Monte Carlo experiments show that our estimators have a good finite sample performance and an empirical application is given to show the usefulness of our estimators.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了带内生性的截断部分线性分位数回归模型的估计问题。我们的方法扩展了部分线性分位数回归（Lee, 2003; Qu等，2024）、非参数分位数回归（Qu和Yoon, 2015; Belloni等，2019）以及带内生性的截断线性分位数回归（Chen, 2018）的相关研究。我们的估计方法采用了一种易于处理的序贯多步骤程序。我们为所提出的估计量建立了均匀一致性、均匀表示及渐近正态性。我们进一步将分析扩展至允许样本选择的情形。一系列蒙特卡洛实验表明，我们的估计量具有良好的有限样本性能，并通过一个实证应用展示了其有用性。
title: Censored partial linear quantile regression with endogeneity
title_zh: 内生性下的删失部分线性分位数回归

abstract: We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of twin defaults : simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在一个银行面临不可分散的借款人违约风险的量化一般均衡模型中，研究了最优资本要求。与标准的银行违约风险模型不同，我们的框架捕捉了贷款组合收益的有限上行空间和显著下行风险。这有助于再现双重违约（即企业与银行同时出现高违约率）的频率与严重程度。因此，最优银行资本要求在降低双重违约频率与限制信贷供给之间进行权衡，其水平高于那些低估借款人违约对银行偿付能力影响的违约风险模型所得到的结果。
title: Twin Defaults and Bank Capital Requirements
title_zh: 双重违约与银行资本要求

abstract: Food production and consumption account for a third of global greenhouse gas emissions (Crippa et al., 2021) and, therefore, offer a large mitigation potential. Policies such as carbon taxation and carbon labelling can contribute to correcting such externalities by encouraging consumers to substitute away from carbon intensive food products. We employ data from a survey-based, randomized experiment simulating an online supermarket, administered to a representative sample of the UK population. Using a structural demand system based on the Exact Affine Stone Index model with censoring, we estimate the greenhouse gas emission reductions and welfare effects associated with a range of demand-side policy scenarios, combining carbon labelling and carbon taxation. Our results show that the application of carbon labels leads to a 5.60% decrease in the carbon content of the average food basket. A £60 tax per tonne of CO 2 e on the most carbon intensive products would yield a 9.89% reduction in the carbon footprint, while also decreasing consumer welfare by £78.71 per person per year. Respectively, these policies would yield a decrease in emissions corresponding to about 2.7% and 4.7% of the GHG emissions of the UK. Combining carbon taxation and carbon labelling allows to reach the same CO 2 e emissions reduction as the carbon tax, with only a £27.86 tax rate per tonne of CO 2 e, thereby reducing welfare losses to £33.52 per person per year. These findings imply that carbon taxation and carbon labelling can be complementary policies to abate greenhouse gas emissions, while limiting the negative impacts on welfare.
abstract_zh: 食品生产与消费占全球温室气体排放的三分之一（Crippa等，2021），因此具有巨大的减排潜力。碳税和碳标签等政策可通过鼓励消费者减少对碳密集型食品的替代，有助于纠正此类外部性。我们利用一项基于调查的随机实验数据，模拟在线超市，并对英国人口代表性样本进行调查。基于精确仿射斯通指数模型并考虑审查机制的结构性需求系统，我们估算了结合碳标签与碳税的一系列需求侧政策情景下的温室气体减排量及福利效应。结果显示，应用碳标签可使平均食品篮的碳含量降低5.60%。对碳密集型产品征收每吨二氧化碳当量60英镑的税收，将使碳足迹减少9.89%，同时消费者福利每年每人下降78.71英镑。相应地，这些政策将分别使排放量减少约英国温室气体排放的2.7%和4.7%。将碳税与碳标签相结合，可在仅征收每吨二氧化碳当量27.86英镑税率的情况下实现与单独碳税相同的二氧化碳当量减排效果，从而将福利损失降至每年每人33.52英镑。这些发现表明，碳税与碳标签可作为互补政策，在减少温室气体排放的同时，限制对福利的负面影响。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: The welfare impacts of carbon taxes and labels on food demand
title_zh: 碳税与食品标签对食品需求福利影响的评估

abstract: In March 2020, Luxembourg became the first country to make public transport free. We use this unique setting to evaluate the policy’s impact on transport emissions using a synthetic difference-in-differences framework. We use spatial emissions data to construct a panel of NUTS 2 regions in the EU from 2016 to 2022. We estimate an average reduction of 5.9% in road transport CO 2 and overall road transport GHG emissions, with larger effects for NO x . These findings are robust against confounding shifts in working from home and commuting patterns, vehicle fleet electrification, and the localized effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Complementary event-study evidence from automatic traffic counters and air quality stations through 2023 corroborates our findings and suggests larger effects on weekends.
abstract_zh: 2020年3月，卢森堡成为首个实现公共交通免费化的国家。我们利用这一独特政策场景，采用合成双重差分框架评估该政策对交通排放的影响。通过使用空间排放数据，我们构建了2016至2022年欧盟NUTS 2区域的面板数据。研究发现，该政策使道路交通二氧化碳及整体道路交通温室气体排放平均降低5.9%，对氮氧化物的减排效果更为显著。这些结论在控制居家办公与通勤模式变化、车辆电动化进程以及新冠疫情局部影响等混杂因素后依然稳健。基于2023年自动交通计数器与空气质量监测站的补充事件研究证据进一步佐证了我们的发现，并表明该政策在周末的减排效应更为显著。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Zero Fare, Cleaner Air? The Causal Effect of Luxembourg’s Free Public Transportation Policy on Transport Emissions
title_zh: 零票价，更清洁的空气？卢森堡免费公共交通政策对交通排放的因果效应

abstract: Suburbanisation is the central force in urban development today. It is particularly impactful in post-socialist countries where its significant momentum and chaotic effects pose challenges to local governance. Although suburbanisation is a well-established field of research, the novelty of this study lies not in reiterating suburban growth itself, but in examining its impact on local governance in suburban municipalities of a post-socialist metropolitan region. The article aims to scrutinise the dynamics of suburbanisation in municipalities adjacent to Kraków and evaluate its effect on governance in the economic, environmental, and societal contexts. The study combines statistical and spatial analyses with surveys conducted among local residents and local authorities, confronting social perceptions with institutional assessments. The results indicate highly dynamic suburbanisation, land cover transformation, pressure towards new infrastructure, and social conflicts, which hinder municipal governance. They also show that the duration of residence significantly differentiates perceptions of suburbanisation-related problems and expectations towards local authorities. By providing evidence from a post-socialist institutional context, the study contributes to international comparative discussions on the diversity of suburbanisation and local governance models. The conclusions emphasise the necessity of implementing integrated and flexible management, reinforcing planning and participatory instruments that support sustainable development, and improving the quality of life.
abstract_zh: 郊区化是当今城市发展的核心动力，尤其在後社会主义国家中影响显著，其强劲势头与混乱效应给地方治理带来挑战。尽管郊区化已是成熟的研究领域，本研究的创新之处并非重述郊区增长本身，而是探讨其对后社会主义大都市区域郊区市镇地方治理的影响。本文旨在审视克拉科夫周边市镇的郊区化动态，并从经济、环境和社会层面评估其对治理的影响。研究结合统计与空间分析，以及对当地居民和地方当局开展的调查，将社会认知与制度评估相对照。结果表明，高度动态的郊区化、土地覆盖变化、新基础设施压力及社会冲突，阻碍了市镇治理。同时，居住时长显著影响居民对郊区化相关问题的认知及对地方政府的期望。通过提供后社会主义制度背景下的实证证据，本研究为郊区化与地方治理模式多样性的国际比较讨论作出贡献。结论强调，必须实施综合灵活的管理，强化支持可持续发展的规划与参与工具，并提升生活质量。
title: Suburbanisation's impact on local government: New spatial management roles and challenges in the suburbs today
title_zh: 郊区化对地方政府的影响：当代郊区空间管理的新角色与挑战

abstract: This paper synthesizes country-level decomposition evidence on the gender gap in agricultural productivity across Sub-Saharan Africa, identifying its major drivers and reviewing what works to close it. Gender productivity gaps range between 7 percent and 77 percent across twelve African countries, with male-managed plots yielding higher outputs than those managed by women. Although controlling for the characteristics of farmers, households and plots tends to shrink this gap, a conditional gap of 4 percent to 62 percent persists. The literature also documents an overall gender gap in agricultural production in the range of 18 percent to 61 percent. The largest driver of these gaps is women’s concentration in lower-value crops, followed by their lower use of and returns from labor. Social norms and access to land and financial resources play a crucial role in sustaining and exacerbating these gender disparities. Evidence suggests that targeted programmatic approaches to increasing women’s adoption of cash crops, enhancing their use of labor and other inputs and providing them with tailored skills and information can help close the gender gap in agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文综合了撒哈拉以南非洲地区农业生产力性别差距的国家层面分解证据，识别其主要驱动因素，并回顾了缩小该差距的有效措施。在十二个非洲国家中，性别生产力差距介于7%至77%之间，男性管理的地块产出高于女性管理的地块。尽管控制农户、家庭和地块特征后，这一差距有所缩小，但条件性差距仍维持在4%至62%之间。文献还记录了农业生产中18%至61%的总体性别差距。这些差距的最大驱动因素是女性集中于低价值作物，其次是她们对劳动力的使用较少且回报较低。社会规范以及土地和金融资源的获取在维持和加剧这些性别差异中起着关键作用。证据表明，通过有针对性的项目方法提高女性对经济作物的采用、增强其劳动力及其他投入的使用，并提供量身定制的技能和信息，有助于缩小农业生产力中的性别差距。
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: The Agricultural Gender Gap in Sub-Saharan Africa: Magnitude, Drivers, and Policy Directions
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业性别差距：规模、驱动因素与政策方向

abstract: The sequence-space Jacobian (SSJ) method of Auclert et al. (2021a) has made heterogeneous-agent models far easier to solve, fueling an explosion of applications. But even SSJ strains against capacity constraints when state spaces grow very large, as in economies with overlapping generations of heterogeneous agents (HA-OLG). We show how to exploit the special properties of age—finite planning horizons and deterministic transitions between ages—to compute the Jacobians of a general class of HA-OLG models orders of magnitude faster. We provide rigorous proofs, age-specific Jacobians that decompose aggregate dynamics across cohorts, an application to the dynamic general-equilibrium effects of secularly declining birth rates, and an accessible cookbook for adopting our method.
abstract_zh: Auclert等人（2021a）提出的序列空间雅可比（SSJ）方法显著简化了异质性主体模型的求解过程，推动了相关应用的爆发式增长。然而，当状态空间规模极大时（例如在包含异质性主体的世代交叠（HA-OLG）经济中），SSJ方法仍面临计算容量约束。我们通过利用年龄的特殊性质——有限规划期与年龄间的确定性转移——将通用HA-OLG模型类别的雅可比矩阵计算速度提升数个数量级。本文提供严格的理论证明、可分解跨队列总体动态的年龄特异性雅可比矩阵、针对长期出生率下降的动态一般均衡效应的应用分析，以及便于采用本方法的实用指南。
title: Sequence-Space Jacobians of Life-Cycle Models
title_zh: 生命周期模型的序列空间雅可比矩阵

abstract: Researchers are faced with the choice of which of the many recently developed difference-in-differences methods to use in practice. To assess these estimators’ relative performance for single-unit event studies, we conduct 134,000+ state-level placebo event studies across 13 estimators. We find that no single method dominates. Performance is context-dependent, with synthetic-control-like methods sometimes outperforming and sometimes underperforming two-way-fixed-effect-like and matching methods. Performance also varies across states at least as much as it does across estimators. Our results highlight the need for practitioners to conduct placebo tests to understand the performance of methods in their research context.
abstract_zh: 研究者面临如何在众多新近发展的双重差分方法中做出实际选择的难题。为评估这些估计量在单单位事件研究中的相对表现，我们基于13种估计量开展了超过13.4万次州级安慰剂事件研究。研究发现，没有任何单一方法具有绝对优势。方法表现具有情境依赖性，合成控制类方法有时优于、有时劣于双向固定效应类方法和匹配方法。各州之间的表现差异至少与不同估计量之间的差异相当。研究结果强调，实践者需开展安慰剂检验以理解其研究情境下各方法的实际表现。
title: An Evaluation of Difference-in-Differences Methods Using Placebo Event Studies
title_zh: 使用安慰剂事件研究评估双重差分方法

abstract: How do labor demand shocks affect workforce diversity in the absence of targeted diversity policies? A conceptual framework illustrates the potential trade-off between the demographic and quality composition of a workforce when there is a positive labor demand shock. Exploiting the German reunification as a natural experiment, we analyze the academic labor market where nearly all social sciences professors in East Germany were replaced while STEM faculty remained largely unchanged. Using administrative data and a regional difference-in-differences design, we find increased dispersion in the institutional quality of hires, indicating that the new hires came from less select departments. At the same time, female representation did not increase despite qualified women in the pipeline. Instead, East German hiring patterns converged to those in West Germany in terms of gender composition. In simulations, we investigate implied losses: Under conservative assumptions, we show that, considering the pipeline of qualified applicants, the marginal female hire’s quality is approximately half a standard deviation higher than the marginal male hire’s quality.
abstract_zh: 在缺乏针对性多元化政策的情况下，劳动力需求冲击如何影响劳动力多样性？一个概念框架揭示了正向劳动力需求冲击下，劳动力人口结构与质量构成之间可能存在的权衡关系。以德国统一作为自然实验，我们分析了学术劳动力市场——东德几乎所有社会科学教授均被替换，而STEM领域教职基本保持不变。基于行政数据与区域双重差分设计，我们发现新聘人员的机构质量离散度上升，表明新入职者来自学术选拔性较低的院系。与此同时，尽管具备资质的女性候选人储备充足，女性代表性并未提升。相反，东德在性别构成上的招聘模式逐渐趋同于西德。通过模拟分析，我们探究了隐含损失：在保守假设下，考虑合格申请者储备池时，边际女性新聘人员的质量比边际男性新聘人员高出约半个标准差。
title: A missed opportunity? Labor demand and workforce diversity
title_zh: 错失良机？劳动力需求与劳动力多样性
